name: Apalachee Audubon Ben Fusaro Conservation Grant
summary: Small grants for grassroots bird-related habitat improvement, research and outreach projects in six Florida Panhandle counties, open to individuals and groups.

geography.label: Leon, Jefferson, Wakulla, Gadsden, Liberty and Franklin counties, Florida

reporting: Grantees write up the project for the chapter newsletter, supply social media content and give a summary or short presentation at a monthly meeting at the end.

calls.label: 2026 Ben Fusaro Conservation Grant

status.quote: Applications will be accepted from Tuesday, September 15, 2026 - Monday, November 30, 2026.

opens.quote: Application Period: Tuesday, September 15, 2026 - Monday, November 30, 2026.

calls.note: Grantees will be announced on January 15, 2027.

applicant_types.quote: Any individual or group wishing to conduct bird-related research, habitat improvement projects, environmental education/outreach, and community engagement

geography.quote: within Leon, Jefferson, Wakulla, Gadsden, Liberty, and Franklin counties.

access.quote: Please submit your materials to apalacheeaudubon@gmail.com with the subject line: 2026 Ben Fusaro Conservation Grant Application

window.quote: Application Period: Tuesday, September 15, 2026 - Monday, November 30, 2026.

reporting.quote: grantees must complete a write-up of their project for our newsletter, the Limpkin Times, and provide content for our social media. Grantees will be required to provide a summary or short presentation at the end of the project during one of our monthly meetings.
